calibration_initialisation_seam.covered: exact closed-form transform of a dual-output ridge fitted on the STANDARDISED embedding back to the raw 64-D embedding affine head (B[j,:]=A[j,:]/sigma[j]; b=c-mu@B), plus expression of (B,b) as the two real Linear(64,1) critic heads; only the two critic heads may be replaced, and replacement is not in place
calibration_initialisation_seam.design_basis: the verified real critic input/affine-head path from ROUND70: value = head(mean over targets of trunk(features)), both real critic heads are Linear(64,1) on the frozen-trunk embedding, so the dual-output affine baseline is the same function class
calibration_initialisation_seam.not_done: no real model opened, no real data fitted, no model weights produced

resource_and_entry_guard.covered: ForwardLedger debits the REAL 19-D input-vector rows BEFORE any forward and refuses before exceeding the cap; billing unit is the target-level input row (never the joint decision row, never the call count); failures, retries and repeats are all charged; the counter persists across instances so a restart does not zero it; batches are grouped by real input rows with a 1024 cap and an oversized single step is reported rather than silently split; DuplicateOutputGuard refuses an implicit re-run over an existing artefact
resource_and_entry_guard.fail_closed: LicenseGate refuses every gated action (real-data fit, model forward, claim write, checkpoint write, episode call, optimizer step, PPO replay, environment build) when no real licence token is present, and the initialiser raises at the FIRST gate so no collaborator runs and no charge occurs
resource_and_entry_guard.not_claimed: the ledger is an in-process guard over a persisted counter; it does NOT claim physical power-loss atomicity, and a spy/no-op is not a real update
resource_and_entry_guard.not_added: no invented conditions such as 'the receipt must live outside the repository' or 'exactly N claim files'
